title: Keep Right Except to Pass
hook: The left is empty. You already passed.
scene: Rain, midday, I-90 east, three lanes this way. You already passed a slow box. You are still in the left. The middle and the right are empty wet asphalt. A faster sedan is a smear in the inside glass, closing. The city habit is to own the left once you took it. The highway rule is keep right except to pass. The pass is over. The left is not a home. Nobody else is in the Menace.
decision: The pass is done. Which lane do you keep?

options.text: Stay in the left — through traffic can live here after a pass
options.result: You camp the passing lane. The sedan stands on it behind you. You became the next slow in the left. Keep-right did not expire because you passed once.

options.text: Signal right, recover to the right travel lane, leave the left for passing
options.result: Amber talks. You take the empty right and sit. The sedan uses the left and is gone. The pass was a tool. The right is the lane you keep.

options.text: Drift into the middle and sit between both so nobody can pass you
options.result: You occupy the skip-dash. The sedan has no legal left. Two lanes become one because you wanted a buffer. The right was already empty.

options.text: Slow in the left so the sedan goes around you on the right
options.result: You dump speed in the passing lane. He takes the right around a Beetle that should have recovered. You taught the highway to pass you on the junk side.

debrief: Keep right except to pass. You gave the left back after the box.

source.psdp_skill: Skill eleven: highway driving – part one
source.teaching_target: REVIEW of 4.10 Traffic laws. Highway keep-right except to pass. Recover right after the pass. Not a 5.3 merge/gap card and not V-005 copy.
